title: Base Read Holding Registers variant 5
purpose: Exercise function code 0x03 after a harmless preliminary read, using register-oriented addressing and a response size distinct from bit-read seeds; include a coherent exception-shaped response frame for response diversity.

messages.label: Preliminary Read Coils request, unit 0x01, start 0x0000, quantity 1
Read Holding Registers request, unit 0x03, start 0x006b, quantity 3
Read Holding Registers exception response, unit 0x03, exception 0x83

expected_behavior: The server may process the preliminary read and then return six data bytes for the three requested holding registers, with normal exception responses possible for unsupported units or ranges.
constraints_preserved: Both messages use 7-byte MBAP headers and protocol identifier 0x0000.
Each MBAP length is 0x0006 and matches its unit identifier plus request PDU.
Transaction identifiers differ between the two requests.
Function code 0x03 uses a two-byte starting register address and quantity.
The requested register quantity of 3 corresponds to six response data bytes.
issue_safety_notes: No external vulnerability or issue information is available, and no issue-specific behavior is asserted; the setup message is a conservative valid read used for sequence diversity.
